nodes.title: Welcome + early onboarding
nodes.purpose: Plays welcome video and early intro screens that offer auth or skip.

files.reason: First visible onboarding surface after splash routing.

nodes.title: Auth providers
nodes.purpose: Google, Apple, email, or anonymous Firebase sign-in creating an AppUser.

files.reason: Implements provider sign-in methods and auth state listener.

nodes.title: Questionnaire + profile
nodes.purpose: Collects questionnaire answers, profile, symptoms, goals, and nutrition setup with resume checkpoints.

files.reason: Persists and restores the current onboarding screen.

nodes.title: Pre-paywall
nodes.purpose: Final commercial gate before MainScaffold for unpaid users.

files.reason: Registers Superwall placements and handles purchase success.

nodes.title: MainScaffold
nodes.purpose: Post-onboarding app shell with bottom navigation.

files.reason: Hosts the signed-in / paid user experience.

edges.label: auth or skip
edges.explanation: Early onboarding screens route the user into Google/Apple/email sign-in or allow skipping toward later anonymous creation.

edges.label: continue funnel
edges.explanation: After identity exists (or skip), navigation continues into questionnaire, profile, and personalization screens.
edges.basis: Order derived from Navigator calls across onboarding screens rather than one central route table.
edges.uncertainty: Exact branch when questionnaire answers are missing uses a shorter path.

edges.label: funnel end
edges.explanation: Completed personalization and benefits screens navigate to PrePaywallScreen.

files.reason: Receives users at the commercial gate.

edges.label: after purchase/skip-paid
edges.explanation: Successful purchase handling or an already-paid check navigates to MainScaffold.

files.reason: Runs post-purchase updates then navigates onward.
